FIELDS.NAME: Fresh Start Laundry Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Fresh Start Laundry Services provides full-service laundry operations, employing a team of trained staff to ensure high-quality cleaning for various types of garments and linens. Our primary services include washing, drying, and pressing clothing, along with specialized cleaning for delicate fabrics. We also offer pick-up and drop-off laundry services for both residential clients and local businesses, including restaurants and healthcare facilities, maintaining strict sanitation protocols to meet regulatory standards. All operations are conducted on-site with robust safety measures in place, ensuring a safe environment for both employees and our customers. Our laundry facility is equipped with modern, environmentally compliant equipment, enabling efficient and eco-friendly cleaning processes. We adhere to all local, state, and federal regulations, underscoring our commitment to quality and safety in our operations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2023, we experienced water damage due to a faulty washing machine hose that resulted in repairs costing $1,200. The status of this loss is closed as repairs have been completed and operations have resumed normally. Additionally, on 08/10/2022, we had a small claim of $1,300 for theft of equipment on the premises, which is also closed after a police investigation.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 Combined Single Limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: "Class 350 safe, UL rated, fire-rated for 1 hour, securely anchored to the floor."
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: On-site security personnel during operating hours and surveillance camera system installed throughout the facility.

The company's operations are conducted with strict adherence to legal and ethical standards.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Fresh Start Laundry Services has not had any policies or coverages declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. All insurance needs are currently being met without any issues.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Fresh Start Laundry Services does not lease employees to or from other employers. All staff members are directly hired and managed by the company.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Fresh Start Laundry Services carries Workers' Compensation insurance, ensuring compliance with statutory requirements and protection for employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Fresh Start Laundry Services also owns and operates Fresh Start Linen Supply Services, providing comprehensive laundry and linen solutions to various clients.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Fresh Start Laundry Services does not have any other insurance with this company at this time. All coverage needs are currently satisfied with the existing policy.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Fresh Start Laundry Services is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on providing high-quality laundry services for garments and linens.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Fresh Start Laundry Services does not rent or loan equipment to others; our operations focus solely on providing laundry services using our own equipment.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Fresh Start Laundry Services has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The financial standing of the business remains stable and compliant with all obligations.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Fresh Start Laundry Services does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or hazardous chemicals as our operations focus on traditional laundry services with standard cleaning agents in compliance with safety regulations. FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Fresh Start Laundry Services does not have any catastrophe exposure, as all operations are conducted in compliance with safety regulations and there are no hazardous activities that could lead to catastrophic events.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Fresh Start Laundry Services has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We maintain strong hiring practices and compliance with all safety regulations to ensure a respectful and safe environment.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Fresh Start Laundry Services has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with all safety regulations. Regular inspections and safety protocols are in place to ensure a safe operational environment.
